# Wocl Leydon

> > Connecticut-based personal injury law firm specializing in accident compensation, medical malpractice, and defective medical device claims with free consultations.

Wocl Leydon is a personal injury law firm headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, recognized by Million Dollar Advocates Forum and Connecticut Super Lawyers. They handle a comprehensive range of injury cases from traffic accidents to complex medical malpractice and product liability claims across Connecticut and surrounding areas.
